item.tib: stag la bkra shis gter rdzong las sbin sreg me dpung rab 'bar
item.coloph: stag la thugs bsgrub bkra shis gter rdzong las/ las mtha' sbyin bsregs ye shes me/ me zor rab 'bar gsang ba'i man ngag 'di / skal ldan grogs kyis nan tan bskul ba'i ngor/ sbas yul smad bkod kyi byang sgo nas/ gser 'phyang gnam lor 'bras yul ljon pa'i tshal/ snyigs ma'i kho bo byang chub snying po yis/ phyi rab don du sbyar ba'i bden pa'i mthus/ sangs rgyas bstan srungs rnal 'byor bar chod zlogs/ g.yung drung bstan pa'i ba dan mchog gyur cig/
